question: Which of the following associations was established by Dr BR Ambedkar in 1930?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Depressed Classes Association**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. BR Ambedkar established the **Depressed Classes Association** in 1930.
 
• The association was formed to uplift the social status of the **Depressed Classes** (Dalits) and fight against caste discrimination.
 
• The Depressed Classes Association played a crucial role in advocating for the rights and education of the marginalized communities in India.
 
• Dr. Ambedkar, being a prominent leader and social reformer, used this platform to raise awareness about the issues faced by the Depressed Classes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Poona Pact (1932)**

 
 
• The Poona Pact was an agreement between Dr. BR Ambedkar and Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• It aimed at providing reserved seats for the Depressed Classes in the provincial legislatures within the general electorate.
 
• This was a significant step towards political representation for the marginalized communities in India.
 
 
 
• **Dr. BR Ambedkar**
 
 
• He was a prominent Indian jurist, economist, and social reformer.
 
• Ambedkar is known as the principal architect of the Indian Constitution.
 
• He dedicated his life to fighting against social discrimination towards the Dalits, women, and labor class.
 
 
 
• **Dalit Movement**
 
 
• The Dalit movement refers to the collective efforts to achieve social equality for the Dalits.
 
• It encompasses a range of activities, including social, political, and economic reforms.
 
• Dr. BR Ambedkar was a leading figure in this movement, advocating for the rights of the oppressed classes.
 
 
 
• **Constitution of India**
 
 
• Dr. BR Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Constitution, adopted in 1950, is the supreme law of India.
 
• It guarantees fundamental rights and ensures social justice and equality for all citizens.
